tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start here to understand what rustplusplus does. The README covers the bot's purpose — bridging Discord and the Rust+ Companion App — along with its feature set: event notifications, smart device control, team chat bridging, and Battlemetrics tracking. The FAQ and feature list fill in operational details.

tour.title: Entry Point & Configuration
tour.description: The bot starts in index.ts, which creates missing directories and bootstraps the DiscordBot. Configuration lives in config/index.js and package.json, defining environment variables, tokens, and dependency versions. The tsconfig.json controls the TypeScript compilation pipeline.

tour.title: Core Bot Structure
tour.description: The two central classes are DiscordBot (the Discord.js client wrapper) and RustPlus (the rustplus.js connection to a Rust game server). Supporting structures like Logger, Map, Team, and Time manage cross-cutting concerns. RustPlusLite provides a lightweight connection variant used during credential pairing.

tour.title: Discord Events
tour.description: When the Discord client emits events, these handlers respond. The ready event finishes setup, interactionCreate routes slash commands and component interactions, messageCreate bridges team chat, and guildCreate onboards new servers. voiceStateUpdate manages proximity voice channels.

tour.title: Rust+ Events & Game Connection
tour.description: The bot connects to Rust game servers via the rustplus.js library and listens for events. The connected handler initializes polling and sets up channels, message handles entity changes (smart switches, alarms, storage monitors) and team chat, while disconnected and error handle reconnection logic.

tour.title: Slash Commands
tour.description: Each file in src/commands/ implements one Discord slash command. Commands range from game-data lookups (craft, recycle, research, decay) to device control (switch, alarm, storagemonitor) and server utilities (map, players, uptime). The credentials command handles Rust+ authentication pairing.

tour.title: Interaction & Domain Handlers
tour.description: Beyond commands, the bot processes button clicks, select menus, and modals through dedicated handlers. Domain-specific handlers manage smart switches, alarms, storage monitors, vending machines, and the information channel. The pollingHandler periodically queries the Rust server for updated state.

tour.title: Discord UI Tools
tour.description: The discordTools layer contains factory functions that build every UI element the bot sends — embeds, buttons, modals, select menus, and text inputs. discordMessages.js orchestrates sending composed messages, while the Setup* files create and manage guild channels, categories, and persistent panels.

tour.title: Data, i18n & Game Knowledge
tour.description: Static JSON files under src/staticFiles/ encode Rust game data — items, crafting recipes, recycling yields, decay rates, CCTV codes, and more. Language files under src/languages/ provide translations for 12 locales. The Items and RustLabs structures load and query this data at runtime.

tour.title: Infrastructure & Deployment
tour.description: The project ships as a Docker container. The Dockerfile and docker-compose.yml define the containerized runtime, while GitHub Actions workflows handle linting and publishing Docker images. Update scripts (update.bat/update.sh) let self-hosted users pull the latest version easily.
